notes: Original research article (論文) in TANSO 2002 [No.205] 231-237, Japanese body with English abstract. I1: the quoted sentence translates as 'Hydrogen adsorption isotherms at 303 K, 0-3.5 MPa were calculated by the volumetric method using a home-made high-pressure hydrogen adsorption apparatus'; 77 and 303 K isotherms up to 0.1 MPa were measured with a BELSORP automatic adsorption apparatus (same section). I2: ACFs are phenolic-resin-based activated carbon fibres (Kynol); SWCNT is HiPco (contains 11 wt% metal per elemental analysis; uptake is reported per SWCNT mass). I3: text also gives 'ACF-2300では0.1MPaで2.3wt%に達する' (77 K, p. 3) and 'ACF-2300でも，3.1MPaで0.26wt%である' (303 K, p. 4). I4: areas are micropore and external specific surface areas from the alpha_s-plot of N2 isotherms at 77 K (Section 2.1, p. 2); no BET total area is given; Table 3 gives Smicro/Sext for Pt-/Pd-loaded samples. Not retracted (record flag false; no statement in PDF); no statement that the uptake data were published before (ref. 32 is the authors' Carbon2002 abstract on adsorption rate of Pd-ACF). First applicable exclusion code is not_english because I1-I4 are met.
